RuleBuilderGuide.guideSubtitle: This tool lets you define which components can be assembled together. Customers use this diagram to build their keyboard without ever worrying about choosing incompatible parts.
RuleBuilderGuide.step1Content: Hold and drag from the Teal dot (output) of the previous component, then drop onto the Blue dot (input) of the next component to establish compatibility.
RuleBuilderGuide.step2Content: Can one Case fit multiple Plates? Just drag multiple wires from that Case to all compatible Plates. Customers will only be able to select what you have connected.
RuleBuilderGuide.step3Content: Click the Copy button under each component to create a clone. Very useful when you want to branch out complex combination rules for the same item.
RuleBuilderGuide.step4Content: Click 'Upload Image' to upload a transparent image of the component. The system will automatically stack these image layers to form a complete keyboard.
RuleBuilderGuide.step5Content: Delete wire: Click to select the wire then press the Delete key. Delete component: Click the Trash icon. (Note: Cannot delete if it is the only remaining clone on the board).
RuleBuilderGuide.step6Content: After completing the diagram, you must click the 'Save Workflow' button in the top corner for the system to apply this new ruleset to your Store.
